title: Block Shape V2 Tree Purity Retrofit
description: Retrofit the already-migrated 🧱️block plugin (✏️s/🔌️plugins/🧱️block/, crate semio-s-plugin-block) from V1 taxonomy shape to Shape V2 tree purity per TEMPLATE.md §14: (1) move 📦️lib.rs into 📦️packages/🦀️rust/📦️lib.rs, update [lib] path and add ../../ prefix to every #[path] string inside it; (2) fold any sibling variant .rs files (config.rs/terminology.rs/wasm.rs/etc beside a component.rs) into their own <folder>/🦀️component.rs, across all 3 apps (◻2d/🧊️3d/🖐️5d) and 🫀️core; (3) relocate any nested 📚️examples/🧫️fixtures/🤖️generated/🛂️manifest.json to the owner root; (4) relocate nested AGENTS.md/README.md to owner root, flagging collision (block already has a root AGENTS.md). Purely mechanical relocation, no logic changes. Baseline: 102/102 tests passing per prior V1 migration ticket BLOCK-PLUGIN-MIGRATION-TO-CRATE-AND-TAXONOMY-CONSOLIDATION.
summary: Retrofitted the already-V1-migrated 🧱️block plugin (3-app: ◻2d/🧊️3d/🖐️5d + 🫀️core cross-artifact kernel) to Shape V2 tree purity per TEMPLATE.md §14. Pure mechanical relocation, zero logic changes: (1) moved 📦️lib.rs into 📦️packages/🦀️rust/📦️lib.rs, updated [lib] path from "../../📦️lib.rs" to "📦️lib.rs", prefixed all 70 non-"." #[path] strings with ../../ (verified every one resolves to a real file on disk via a Python walk); (2) folded 7 sibling variant files (config.rs×3, terminology.rs×3, world.rs×1) across all 3 apps into their own component folders (🎚️config/, 🗣️terminology/, 🌍️world/ — matching the exact folder-emoji convention already established by the already-retrofitted mathematical/procedural/space/etc plugins); (3) merged the 3 per-app 📚️examples/ dirs (6 fixture files, no filename collisions) into one owner-root 📚️examples/, and repointed the 3 dsl component.rs include_str! call sites that embedded them (pattern cross-checked against procedural's identical convention); (4) confirmed no AGENTS.md/README.md collision — only the pre-existing root AGENTS.md exists, nothing nested. Final find-based audit confirms the tree contains nothing but component.rs/plain folders/📦️packages below the owner root (81 files total). Registrar handoff is empty — grep for the old owner-root 📦️lib.rs path found zero external references. BLOCKED on live cargo verification: root cargo check/test hard-fails on a dangling norm-plugin workspace member manifest path (📕️norm's own in-flight migration, confirmed unrelated, reproduced 4x across the session including a final retry after all edits) — did careful manual verification instead (full detail in 🧪️verification.txt): every #[path] resolves, Cargo.toml diff shows only the [lib] path line changed, every use crate::apps::block{2d,3d,5d}::{config,terminology,world}::... call site across 70+ usages remains valid since module names were never renamed (only their #[path] targets moved). Baseline was 102/102 tests (prior V1 ticket) — expected unchanged once cargo can run again, since this retrofit touched zero logic.
